title: Count Total Products
description: Write a query that returns the total number of products in the catalog, as `total_products`.
hints: Same COUNT(*) pattern again, on products this time.
Select COUNT(*) aliased as total_products, from products.
expected_behavior: Returns one row, one column (total_products), the number of rows in products.
solution: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM products;
explanation: Three questions in a row (orders, customers, products) all reduce to the exact same COUNT(*) pattern on a different table - recognizing that repetition is itself a useful skill.
